head_commit.message:
Prevent stale voice answers from reappearing during speech recovery (#47975)

## Why

Queued voice answers could reappear as text under a newer question when speech failed, the pending queue overflowed, or voice stopped, including answers already spoken as paraphrases.

## What changed

Filter recovered and replayed speech by the current input generation, preserving that generation across conversation resets. Keep text fallbacks for answers still awaiting turn completion so delayed user transcripts do not discard unspoken answers.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for paraphrased answers, queue overflow, stop and replay, failed delivery for current versus superseded input, and delayed transcripts.

head_commit.message:
## New Features

- Added GPT-6 Sol and Luna, including Amazon Bedrock support and migration prompts for older models. (#47332, #47347)
- Enabled fullscreen transcripts by default and added Shift-click to extend text selections. (#47178, #47414)
- Enabled automatic background-server startup for eligible interactive sessions, with recovery choices when server settings are incompatible. (#47179, #47318)
- Added an `f` shortcut to fork conversations open in another app, preserving drafts and queued prompts. (#47185)
- Made `/import` available in remote sessions and local background-server sessions. (#47317)
- Improved terminal rendering with Unicode bullets, checkboxes, aligned equations, and optimization notation. (#47191, #47322)

## Bug Fixes

- Preserved active voice conversations when switching threads. (#47381)
- Recovered unsent question answers into the composer when turns end, without disrupting active history searches. (#47422, #47423)
- Respected tmux mouse settings and restored native scrollback for Terminal.app over SSH in automatic screen mode. (#47399, #47417)
- Fixed configured proxy routing for realtime connections and standalone web search, including search redirects. (#47101, #47142, #47204)
- Added retries for transient file-upload failures and increased the upload timeout to five minutes. (#47122, #47393)
- Enforced network restrictions across redirects and ongoing HTTP and WebSocket traffic, including cancellation when policy changes revoke access. (#47389, #47407)

Filter recovered and replayed speech by the current input generation, preserving that generation across conversation resets. Keep text fallbacks for answers still awaiting turn completion so delayed user transcripts do not discard unspoken answers.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for paraphrased answers, queue overflow, stop and replay, failed delivery for current versus superseded input, and delayed transcripts.

head_commit.message:
Preserve Git directory protections across writable roots (#47974)

## Why

A `.git` pointer can resolve to a Git directory inside another writable root. Broader Seatbelt grants or later bubblewrap mounts can leave that directory writable despite its metadata protections.

## What changed

Include resolved Git directories in read-only exclusions for broader writable roots on Linux and macOS. Resolve symlink aliases when locating exclusion targets and retain explicit policy overrides.

## Testing

Add regression tests for Git directories reached directly or through symlink aliases in another writable root, and for linked worktree metadata under the macOS temporary directory. Verify that metadata writes are denied while ordinary files in the surrounding writable root remain writable.

head_commit.message:
Expose current environment selections for a running turn (#47970)

## Why

`active_turn_environment_selections()` returns the selections captured at turn start, so it does not reflect later environment settings updates.

## What changed

Add `CodexThread::current_turn_environment_selections(expected_turn_id)` to read the running turn's current selections, including environments that are still starting or have failed. Return `None` when the requested turn is no longer active or has been cancelled.

## Testing

Add a regression test covering selection updates, mismatched turn IDs, and completed turns, while verifying that the initial selection snapshot remains unchanged.
